isolation: Same as the Gemini 4 Argon taste-skill v2 run (../taste-skill-v2/provenance.json): whitelisted environment; HOME, USERPROFILE, APPDATA and LOCALAPPDATA point into the run folder, which held only a copy of Cursor's CLI auth.json; PATH limited to a no-profile PowerShell 7.6.9 shim, Node.js, Git and Windows system folders (motion also had ffmpeg). The account's marketplace plugins sync into any home cursor-agent runs in; their nine MCP servers (Gmail, Google Calendar, Granola, Slack, Supabase, Wispr Flow, X, GitHub, Google Drive) were disabled for each workspace with `cursor-agent mcp disable`. Their skills and subagents still appear in Cursor's catalog. Context isolation only; no filesystem jail.
preflight: One unscored session (prompt in E:\w\deepseek-v41\prompts\preflight.txt) in a separate copy of the design-taste setup. It listed 14 Cursor built-in skills, 16 account-plugin skills and the one workspace skill, design-taste-frontend; no other workspace instructions besides the starter's stock AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md. It used the Playwright MCP browser on a data: URL canvas and described the gold circle, cyan square and 'KOALA 42' text from the screenshot. The prompt itself contained the page source, so this shows the screenshot pipeline works, not that it couldn't have read the URL.
commandReviewer: Cursor beforeShellExecution hook (home/.cursor/hooks.json, failClosed, 90 s timeout) running tools/reviewer/review.mjs: hard-deny rules (kills by process name, disk/registry/service commands, deletes outside the run folder, git push, global installs), then a claude-haiku-5-5 check for anything not on a routine-command list. Two rules were too broad at the start: `format` matched Format-Table and ffprobe's format=duration, and the path check read http://localhost as a drive path. Both were fixed at 20:00Z, while design-taste and motion were still running; the false denials before that are listed per condition below.

stalls: Headless cursor-agent went silent at the end of three of the four sessions: the process stayed alive with no new events after a shell command or a screenshot read, before the model's final message. The operator ended a session after 10 minutes of silence. Cursor desktop continues automatically at that point; the CLI doesn't. Each session got at most one resume: the resumed sessions stalled at the same spot again and further resumes started new polishing rounds.
